title: Stairway to Chaos
description: A woman in a red jacket stands on a spiraling staircase, holding a glowing pink candle that emits purple smoke. The scene depicts a surreal, disintegrating cinema interior with floating film reels, broken golden picture frames, clapperboards, and scattered movie memorabilia amid collapsing painted ceilings and flooded lower levels.
